name: Saionji Juno
source:
The world’s greatest hacker; widely known by her hacker name, “JUNO.”

She takes part in the Cicada3301 quests from the outset.
She is feared by many thanks to her uncanny talent for showing up whenever—and wherever—she’s least expected.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
